text: # Chest radiograph decision-support notes (public sources) This file is a **research knowledge snippet**, not a care protocol. ## Scope Chest radiographs may appear similar across viral and bacterial pneumonia. Imaging must be interpreted with clinical history, vital signs, and laboratory tests. FedXAI-Med model output is an AI-assisted research prediction, **not a diagnosis**. ## Public references (titles only; retrieve the original documents yourself) 1. World Health Organization. Use of chest imaging in COVID-19: a rapid advice guide. 2020. 2. American College of Radiology. ACR Appropriateness Criteria — Acute Respiratory Illness. 3. WHO. Clinical management of COVID-19: living guideline. Do not treat heatmaps as proof of disease. Do not invent additional citations.
